definitions.explanation: A person who shares the same beliefs, goals, or cause.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な{同志|どうし}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同志|どうし}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{同志|どうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{固|かた}い→固い：12090_katai⟧⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結|むす}ばれている→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: We are bound by strong ties as comrades.

examples.japanese: {同志|どうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}び{合|あ}った→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: The comrades called out each other's names.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共|とも}にした→共に：03468_tomoni⟧{同志|どうし}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: We are comrades who shared hardships together.

examples.japanese: {同志|どうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
{同志|どうし}たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: We move toward our goal with our comrades.

notes:
{同志|どうし} refers to people who share common goals or beliefs.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {同志|どうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (gather like-minded people)
- {同志|どうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as comrades)

USAGE:
- Can have political connotations (communist/socialist movements)
- Also used more generally for allies with shared goals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: companion, colleague (everyday)
- {同志|どうし}: comrade (ideological connotation)
- ⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧: fellow ~, among ~ (a different word with the same reading, used after a noun: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧, ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧); 'fellow students' is never written ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{同志|どうし}
- ⟦{同胞|どうほう}→同胞：23023_douhou⟧: compatriot, fellow countryman
